items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/75d5080ce3e7fca4047296a551ad8d57e0b4fed7.jpg"]

We're back with a new FREE update for the game featuring the previously announced MOON CHILD collaboration and a special free song addition to celebrate the launch of upcoming PC rhythm game In Falsus.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/c704840779a1edfd6445b62771a502e722271a5a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/a0be8ffe43fb43d32a3fb54a8f15b100b511f20c.png"]

To start, we're launching with an unprecedented four new songs in this update: MOON CHILD (UNBEATABLE'S LOVEADELIC RPG ADVENTURE REMIX) is a new in-house production remixing the 1997 original theme, and the classic Amiga and Windows versions are also playable too. Huge thanks to Metin Seven and Ramon Braumuller for allowing us to do this! If you like our brand new rendition of the titular theme, it's available to listen on our Bandcamp! See here:

Lastly, "Cryogenic" by Camellia ft. Petra Gurin, the marquee track for lowiro's new rhythm game, In Falsus, has been added as as playable track! In Falsus is a narrative-heavy rhythm game from the studio behind Arcaea, which we previously featured music from earlier in the year. We're honored to work with them again and celebrate their next release - which we think undeniably rules. If you enjoyed playing the song in UNBEATABLE, we highly recommend checking out In Falsus when it releases on September 9th, wishlistable here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971950/In_Falsus/"]
Save System has been fully reworked to prevent save data loss and corruption. It should now be impossible for partially written or empty files to overwrite existing save data.
Game file size has been slightly cut down.
You can now jump right into playing the marquee setpieces in the game's EPISODE SELECT, assuming you've already played through it on your save.
Major optimizations have been made to decrease CPU and GPU load across Story Mode and Arcade Mode.
Various fixes / adjustments to the Chinese / Japanese localizations:
\[SIMPLIFIED CHINESE] Fixed a line in CHAPTER 3 that mistranslated "BAR" as “RAMEN BAR”.
\[SIMPLIFIED CHINESE] Fixed “TIMING OFFSET” being mistranslated.
\[SIMPLIFIED CHINESE] Fixed Quaver's name being incorrectly translated phonetically in the subtitles during the leadup to the Chapter 1 Setpiece.
\ Fixed “BANG!” subtitles having awkward writing.
\ Fixed incorrectly formatted subtitles in the final setpiece.
Fixed text sizing on the pause menu in CHINESE and JAPANESE localizations.

Added the following songs to the ARCADE MODE: MOON CHILD (UNBEATABLE'S LOVEADELIC RPG ADVENTURE REMIX), MOON CHILD (WINDOWS MIX), MOON CHILD (AMIGA MIX), and "Cryogenic" by Camellia ft. Petra Gurin (from In Falsus)
Various fixes to rhythm game bugs.
Fixed a UI issue related to normal difficulty song and beatmap information
Minor improvements to latency in the core rhythm gameplay. More are being worked on!

This patch is available only on PC for now - because of scheduling conflicts with our porting house, the size of work on this patch, and ongoing work on the Switch 2 port, we have to shift the console update timeline slightly; rather than push back all updates, we're looking into bundling up several updates to drop on console in a single patch. This will help us ensure that everything launches as intended, and will also make sure console releases have all the PC hotfixes baked in at launch.
Of course, we still want to make sure consoles get these updates in a timely manner, so hang tight! We appreciate your patience in the meantime, and will share more details when we can!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/fd718fcddfb57175221152beae572359a899eb8f.png"]

UNBEATABLE's music just got nominated for the WSA's Game Music Award! We're up against the likes of Ryan Lott's incredible, atmospherically eerie work on Marathon and Andrew Arcadi's 80s-inspired soundscape for Dispatch. This is a huge honor - although we'll probably need to figure out how to get to the festival first! Check out all the nominees here.
As always, more soon.
<3 FROM D-CELL
Hey! I’m sorry because this is a bad news announcement. I hate writing these and you hate reading them but I promise we’ll get through this together.
A bit under a month ago, we announced that the Jamie Paige Content Companion was going to arrive on July 27th.
That’s still happening!

However, we said that the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the game would come out simultaneously with that, and that isn’t happening. The Switch 2 version of the game is being delayed for a short bit. We don’t have a release date quite yet.
Keep in mind, by the way, that this really only affects the digital launch; physical should still be coming alongside the other console versions of the game!

I want to be very transparent about why this delay is happening: this time it’s not anything game breaking…it’s just not running as well as we want it to be. It’s chugging in some scenes and it detracts from the experience. And, especially given how much work we’ve done over the last few months to smash bugs and improve performance on both PC and console branches, we really don’t want to put a bad foot forward here. Both for you and us, frankly! I’m sure you get that.

This isn’t the outcome anyone wanted, obviously, but I want to be clear that D-CELL ourselves (as well as Playstack!) pushed for this delay internally after reviewing how the port’s performance was coming along. We’ll be working closely to try to get the experience to a solid high frame rate.

We’ll let you know when the new release date is as soon as we know. It shouldn’t be that long, but given cert timelines it’s hard to give an estimate. I know this is disappointing! This sucks, actually! But it would suck way more (again, both for you and us) if it came out and didn’t run well, especially all these months after launch.
I know you’ve all looked forward to the Switch 2 launch. You’ll just be looking forward for a little longer.
-RJ and D-CELL

March's monthly patch is OUT! You now get to look at more than exactly one thing in the background when playing most songs in arcade mode. Plus: more things

The game has been moved over to Unity 6 from a much older version to help future-proof the game and make it a little more extendable and updatable; we avoided doing this for a long time because I don't know if you know this but any time you move to a new version of the game engine you're using Everything Breaks.
Which is why we tested it a lot before doing this, and from our testing nothing should be broken, but please tell us if this actually isn't true

The move to Unity 6 may extremely negligibly improve performance for some! Hooray! More optimizations directly on the game itself are being made behind the scenes and those will be added into the game once we ensure stability later in the year.
GO FIGURE and ALTERNATIVE POLICING STRATEGY are both now playable in arcade mode.
A new STAR chart has also been added for Proper Rhythm (STAR Lesson).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/4da18fbf87fca7511bd884bb948d3645be4c7182.png"]

The big marquee thing though is that 15+ playable stages have been added to arcade mode. By default, we've configured it so songs are set to certain stages, but you can override this if you want to defy god
Some of these stages are locked behind Story Mode progress and will unlock automatically if you've already completed those chapters.
I'm very excited for you to all simultaneously to discover what one of the stages we added is and do the thing we expect you to do as a result
Fixed how challenges are fired off upon game bootup to prevent the likelihood of missing story mode related challenge unlocks.
Fixed various challenges, notably more challenges in Folio 12 and the Birthday one.
Adjusted how scores merge - Full Combo flags and ranks are now saved separately from score, meaning these won't be overwritten if you got a higher point score but lower rank / no full combo.
You can now toggle color-coded accuracy judgments, which will change the color of each judgment to help better distinguish them.
File Size: We've found ways where we can significantly cut down file size for the game and will make these optimizations in a later patch!

Game Performance: Optimizations are still under way but is something we're handling delicately as we can. We've noticed some of the new stages added may have differing performance from the original train station - remember that you can change the stage back at any time!
Fail-Restart and Improvements to Game Offset Sync: Still in the oven, we promise.

"Spike Note Bugs": Still being worked on! Please hit us up about these if you notice them, as they're in the center of the unfortunate venn diagram between "only extremely skilled players will notice this" and "it only happens to some people," which makes them difficult to test.
As always, just because we didn't mention an issue here does not mean we aren't aware of it!

<3 FROM D-CELL GAMES
Hi! D-CELL is officially on holiday break until early January (we are tired,) but we've got one last tiny little present for you before end of year.

That! As part of the change to the save system we made to help facilitate this, we also added multiple save slots. You get three of them! That felt like the right number, to me. Also, importantly, episode select is universal, so you can start a new file from Episode 2 if you want. That's everyone's favorite episode, anyway

Replaying episode one takes you back to the intro sequence, which a lot of people requested. You no longer need to scoop out your save file to hear me say "mic check" slowed down and distorted in your left ear.
Railgrinding is a little tighter and a little better and now has sound effects! You will know now much more intimately if you fail a note.
We fixed a lot of miscellaneous related bugs softlocking the game if the player had the audacity to pause the game in the middle of them

Unsimilarly but semantically related: sometimes the game would not be paused behind the pause menu despite the pause menu being paused. This pause problem has been put on pause, and the game should now always pause when you pause.
Brickout is not supposed to have a multi-paddle upgrade. What a nightmare that was! Thank god we fixed that. Who would have wanted to play an easier version of Brickout?
Walking too far ahead of Quaver and then entering cutscenes used to have a chance of softlocking the game and that's fixed now! Hooray

The sewer had some triggers that were accessible before you were supposed to see them and I know that sounds very fun as a player of video games but it just made everything more confusing (unintentionally) and the game is already confusing (intentionally) enough.
Starting the arcade quest without Treble in your party could freeze the game. This is fixed now. I'm surprised this is a thing anyone did
There was a softlock when interacting with the bulletin board in front of the school building. This was my fault, there was a typo in the code. It's ok to yell at me for this
Multiple collision issues have been fixed. Beat should no longer suddenly decide to live next to a janitor's shed forever
Sometimes the Bioacoustics door would not let you enter it. Technically, this makes sense if you think about it, but also it ruined the game
Several challenges that were not unlocking properly should now work correctly. Sorry for this one,
Resolution should save properly when opening a new arcade mode session, now.
We're still looking at granular setpiece replay options. We'll talk more about this...in January!
We will also talk about fail restart in January.
Also also in January: a lot of microfixes to some small beatmapping issues and transitions too sudden to react to.
Also also also in January (wow): more stage backgrounds for arcade mode!
More robust save features (including a lot of microstate stuff around dialogue choices) are coming in the future now that we have episode select and multisave working.
More performance improvements! There are always going to be some of these. We'll keep doing it little by little. (fun fact: that means "poco a poco" in English.)

More improvements to dialogue pacing and scene flow stuff will continue to happen to ensure interruptions only happen when they're sup• And a million bug fixes as usual forever! Please continue to send bug reports to the official form!
And that's it. HAPPY HOLIDAYS TO ALL! Sorry we don't have a novelty Christmas single free DLC for you. I'll bug the team to do that next year
-rj

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053785/136839633c71ea10962f241fc5083cfd30af5671.png"]
Hi! We (think) we fixed some more things already!
GENERAL FIXES

An option for "Higher Compatibility Videos" has been added to the options menu. If things still break with FMVs in any regard, please flip this on. If this still doesn't work, talk to us gently and we will go back into the mines on your behalf
Pausing during the slowdown on the final hit of a song should no longer break everything
Pausing after that hit should no longer require an input to move forward
You should no longer be softlocked during the performance in the lighthouse if you try to restart over and over or quit at the end, thus saving you from even more embarrassment than is intended
Snacks can no longer freeze the game and/or you. (This statement only applies to the game, of course. Some snacks in real life can still freeze you if you're not careful.)
The pathing to go fix what's causing havoc at the arcade could previously break, and now it shouldn't.

Sometimes you could accidentally progress time on the first day of this episode. In real life, that's called "spacing out." In the game, that's called "unintended behavior." Beat does enough intended spacing out as it is, frankly. Any weird or broken save files caused by this bug should be automatically fixed!
And on top of this a handful of other broken dialogue triggers were also fixed. Who needs 'em.
The challenge "if the game isn't broken, you already have this" now works properly
Feel free to screenshot that out of context
Episode select is coming soon. We're targeting this week, because we want to get it done and out before D-CELL goes on a holiday break.
Setpiece replay, as well (that's probably not this week, though. Give it time).
Fail-restart instead of fail forward
Tons more performance improvements
Tons more bug fixes (as goes without saying, fixing a bug here does not mean we are ignoring a bug that hasn't been fixed yet!)
And other features in the future...

Continue to send bug reports via our bug report form here. I'm sure you would anyway, but also if you want us to actually fix it it helps that it all goes to the same place: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe55RWKCW18rEJcrzNDnVciAyjdw0Z_a-893GJgaqrnSd4Lyw/viewform
(<3 d-cell)
GENERAL
Many small performance improvements and many general softlocks fixed
Video playback on Proton/Linux should be working now. If it doesn't, please yell at me
EPISODE ONE
Sometimes during the intro of the game you were unable to get into the main corridor to get on stage. You will no longer hold up the concert of a lifetime.
EPISODE TWO
Beat occasionally stared so hard at a lightbulb that it crashed the game. That is now fixed.
Performance should be much better during fight scenes, especially on lower bound hardware.
After day 2, the game refused to move forward. You may have felt similarly, which is intentional, but the game not moving forward was not intentional
"Talk Icon (Clone)" was an icon that popped up as if it was a person to talk to. That was a trick and a mistake and has been fixed.
EPISODE THREE
Whacktown could lock up if you tried fighting a ghost at a time you were not supposed to. Technically, I suppose, there's never a good time to fight a ghost.
When Beat caused a breaker trip, it would occasionally also break the game. It no longer breaks the game.

On the final day, people could, if they got lost enough, find a dialogue node that shouldn't exist which would lock the game up. They can't do that any more, and also we're a bit more insistent that they go where they should.
EPISODE FOUR
After finishing the first concert you would sometimes get punted into a time loop. And, like, the song is all about doing the same thing over and over, but not like that .
When trying to find Treble the player would be forced into a looking animation they couldn’t get out of.
You could get into a courtyard you’re not supposed to be in in the school area, causing a softlock as you can't get out of the courtyard at all.
Penny no longer disappears when she shouldn't.
You can no longer walk into a toilet.
ARCADE
Keybinds weren't saving properly. It's confusing if you come back only for up to be down! It should be fine now.
A cheat code has been added to unlock songs you could only get otherwise through story mode.
Full changelog available here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16iNrsy2V7FvPYfmiMaAvH_JMUQSh5Wgxtaln8QAsoz0/edit?tab=t.0

notes.title: HOW MUCH OF THE GAME IS LEFT TO MAKE

items.text: BEFORE WE ACTUALLY ANSWER THAT we need to be thanking you all yet again. The game has had a crazy reception both by our longtime fans (that's you guys here on Kickstarter and also those who have been with us even longer) and some new ones (I'd say hi to you but you aren't probably reading this. You're reading the version of this post we're putting elsewhere, and that version of this post doesn't have this parenthetical. Unless someone messed something up). The steam page has cleared 150k wishlists and it keeps moving like a train and we're so grateful we're going to explode.

After our big re-announcement (and also before that re-announcement) we've been slamming out several of the game’s chapters simultaneously. To answer that question, though...quite a bit is left! That's how it goes.

BUT DO NOT WORRY. We’ve gotten a lot of work done on getting this closer to being an actual honest to god video game that we can put on your television. Your wait has been Far Too Long, and things always feel like they move Far Too Slow (if 1: you want it faster and 2: you or someone you know wins the lottery then 3: talk to us) but games are work and this is work and we want this thing to work and that takes...effort
So what have we been efforting on? Well, there’s a lot shown in the trailer (and past material) that you haven’t seen yet and for today…it’ll continue to be that way!~
